name: Orangehrm
description: OrangeHRM open source HR management software.
composeYaml:
services:
  orangehrm:
    image: 'orangehrm/orangehrm:latest'
    platform: linux/amd64
    environment:
      - ORANGEHRM_DATABASE_HOST=mariadb
      - 'ORANGEHRM_DATABASE_USER=${MYSQL_USER}'
      - 'ORANGEHRM_DATABASE_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}'
      - 'ORANGEHRM_DATABASE_NAME=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-orangehrm-db}'
    volumes:
      - 'orangehrm-data:/orangehrm'
    depends_on:
      mariadb:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
  mariadb:
    image: 'mariadb:11'
    volumes:
      - 'orangehrm_mariadb_data:/var/lib/mysql'
    environment:
      - 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MYSQLROOT_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MYSQL_DATABASE=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-orangehrm-db}'
      - 'MYSQL_USER=${MYSQL_USER}'
      - 'MYSQL_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - healthcheck.sh
        - '--connect'
        - '--innodb_initialized'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
